decision.reason: The public provider and draft cannot execute the required 4K suite, budget 6 is unsupported, and the only exact verifier is 0.8726x serial MTP. Sweeping budgets 1-4 at <=1K would fit the wrong depth and fixed evaluation prompts.
decision.unblock: Extend request-owned draft KV/index capacity and provider contract to at least 4K, implement budget 6 only after RED coverage, and produce an exact operation-complete verifier that beats serial MTP. Then fit on unrestricted disjoint telemetry and evaluate the complete long-context/category-heldout suite.
